mentions.name: HTML-to-RSS feed updater
mentions.description: A tool that parses a website's HTML across many pages and links and updates an RSS feed with filtering support, so changes can be tracked through an RSS aggregator instead of by manually checking the site.
mentions.problem: Manually checking a website and losing track of what has or hasn't been reviewed.
mentions.audience: Personal use (the author's own site-monitoring workflow)
mentions.source_excerpt: Parsing a website's HTML (lots of pages, lots of links) to update an RSS feed that accepts filters. Rather than manually checking a website and losing track of what I have or haven't reviewed, the idea is to feed it into an RSS aggregator.

evidence.value: Parsing a website's HTML (lots of pages, lots of links) to update an RSS feed that accepts filters. Rather than manually checking a website and losing track of what I have or haven't reviewed, the idea is to feed it into an RSS aggregator.
